notes: «أن إسماعيل بن جعفر، حدثهم» is rule 5 («أن X حدثه»): Isma'il is a link, the source of the Abbad route
«قال وقال جعفر ابنة عمي» is inside the story; Ja'far is not a link (rule 6)
Ali is the Companion whose account of the custody dispute is the saying, so he is the last link; the Prophet's judgment is inside the story
